spec.description: Cross-split robustness: eval 8 seed checkpoints with independent split, compare with corrected_eval 55.7±5.0%
spec.eval_data: episode-level split, 300 val samples from 10 episodes

experiment_data.hypothesis: 验证 8-seed router checkpoints 在独立 split（非训练 split）上的 balanced_acc 是否与 corrected_eval（55.7±5.0%）一致（Δ<2pp），确认 ga=8 训练 split-robust、论文数字可靠。
